title: Littlewood Conjecture
exact_target: Can any two real numbers be simultaneously approximated with a common denominator so that Littlewood's scaled error product becomes arbitrarily small?

sources.citation: Steven Robertson, Combinatorics on Number Walls and the P(t)-adic Littlewood Conjecture, Section 1, 2025 revision.
Disproof of the uniform Littlewood conjecture.
The uniform Littlewood conjecture fails on a set of positive Hausdorff dimension.
